title: stock — 3-step routing AWT-prep + source deep (GAP-030)
gap_finding: Three-step inbound (Supplier->Input->QC->Stock) and outbound (Stock->Pack->Output->Customer) routing logic is fully source-proven; runtime sequential execution of push-chained transfers is NOT_PROVEN and requires AWT verification on a live instance.
l1_applicability: APPLICABLE — manifest declares stock v1.1 depending on product, barcodes_gs1_nomenclature, digest
l2_applicability: APPLICABLE — reception_steps, delivery_steps selection fields; wh_qc_stock_loc_id, qc_type_id, store_type_id relation fields on stock.warehouse
l3_applicability: APPLICABLE — _create_or_update_route builds route and rules from get_rules_dict; state chain Supplier->Input->QC->Stock defined at lines 777-780
l4_applicability: APPLICABLE — _run_push (stock_rule.py:222) and _push_apply (stock_move.py:1214) are the cross-model chain mechanism
l5_applicability: APPLICABLE — stock_warehouse_views.xml:38-41 exposes reception_steps/delivery_steps radio widgets gated by group_adv_location
l6_applicability: APPLICABLE — group_adv_location security group (stock_security.xml:50-52); multi-company record rules on stock.warehouse, stock.rule, stock.route
l7_applicability: APPLICABLE — Multi-Step Routes toggle (res_config_settings.py:23-25) must be enabled; implied_group=stock.group_adv_location prerequisite
l8_applicability: APPLICABLE — first rule make_to_stock, subsequent make_to_order (stock_warehouse.py:834); last rule propagate_cancel forced False (line 851)
l9_applicability: N/A — no accounting postings in routing logic
l10_applicability: APPLICABLE — _run_scheduler_tasks (stock_rule.py:693) triggers procurement and reservation via cron
l11_applicability: APPLICABLE — Procurement NamedTuple (stock_rule.py:31) is the public procurement API entry point
l12_applicability: AWT-REQUIRED — GAP-030 runtime execution of 3-step sequences not proven; 3 AWT claims defined
key_finding: The 3-step routing chain is fully declarative in source: get_rules_dict at stock_warehouse.py:777-788 defines all Routing objects; _get_rule_values at line 834 enforces make_to_order chaining; _push_apply at stock_move.py:1214 and _run_push at stock_rule.py:222 execute the chain at runtime. The chain is AWT-READY: 3 test scenarios cover inbound sequence, outbound sequence, and cancel boundary.

awt_test_plans.title: Three-Step Inbound Execution
awt_test_plans.steps: Enable Multi-Step Routes; set warehouse inbound to three-step; create and validate receipt; confirm QC transfer auto-created; validate QC; confirm Storage transfer auto-created; validate Storage; confirm product at stock location

awt_test_plans.title: Three-Step Outbound Execution
awt_test_plans.steps: Enable Multi-Step Routes; set warehouse outbound to three-step; confirm delivery order; verify PICK created; validate PICK; verify PACK created; validate PACK; verify OUT delivery fires; validate OUT; confirm delivery done

awt_test_plans.title: Cancel Propagation Boundary
awt_test_plans.steps: Follow AWT-01 through QC transfer creation; cancel QC; confirm Storage is cancelled; confirm no downstream customer-facing move is cancelled
